AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VII
Dr. Mara Vey

You can see the fires from the Continuity roof. Not Grey Bloom. Not all of them. Some districts are being deliberately burned. Some are simply burning because emergency services stopped reaching them.
The news says Karsic weapons struck the outer industrial zone. Military says several detonations were our own Firebreak operations. Nobody knows which explosions belong to which war anymore.
I lived here for nine years. There was a bakery beneath my apartment. A terrible little place with excellent coffee. I keep thinking about it.
The capital is burning and my mind keeps insisting that somewhere beneath that smoke is a table where I used to eat breakfast.

AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VIII
Emergency Broadcaster
This is not a test. All remaining civilians capable of independent movement should leave central Cyranth using northern evacuation corridors.
Do not approach government district checkpoints. Do not approach active Firebreak zones. Do not travel east. Rail service has ended. Municipal water should be considered unreliable.
Carry filtration equipment if available. Do not enter underground transit tunnels displaying visible Grey Bloom. If you cannot evacuate, proceed to a registered shelter and conserve supplies.
The Commonwealth government remains operational. The Commonwealth government remains operational. Good luck.
